description: This file contains script functions related to the platform-specific upgrade process for OpenWrt firmware on the ramips/rt3883 hardware platform. It defines functions to check the image and perform the upgrade, with default behavior for upgrade execution.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, delegating to default_do_upgrade or other logic based on the board name.
